# AK GC Top 10 — Would Not Benefit (2nd refresh)

**Audience:** Board / Rainmaker
**Set:** Site Scout `would_not_benefit` only (**144 rows**; was **105** at last refresh; was 40 at Stage3)
**Gold standard:** https://farnorthgc.com
**Date:** 2026-09-15 (AK / America/Anchorage)
**Refresh driver:** Continued SERP/domain_probe expanded verified sites; Top10 rebuilt from **current** would_not_benefit only

## TLDR

- Set grew **105 → 144** (+39). Big growth is **out-of-state corporate** (`national_or_out_of_state_brand` 6→38), not new local remodel gold. Scout gold-bar free-text still ~52; after collision/OOS reclass, `at_or_above_gold` is **45** (was 51).
- **Mostly unchanged list among survivors.** 7 of 10 prior Top10 still in set and kept. **3 prior winners left the WNB set** (Rickman #1, Roybal #7, CMC #8) — slots refilled; not competitive displacement.
- Only **one** strong brand-new remodel-adjacent gold add survives spot-check: **Husband For An Hour** (Fairbanks). Other “new AK gold” probes were domain collisions (chiro / therapy / education center).
- Two additional Top10 seats filled from prior mid-pack gold still in set: **Golden Hammer** (residential GC remodel) + **Bigfoot Decking** (remodel-adjacent).
- Wheeler promoted to **#1** (closest residential remodel GC peer remaining).
- **Card ≠ GO.** No outreach until Board asks.

## Scout / SERP caveats (carry forward)

- SERP resolve: domain_probe_v2 + prior hints; **Prana Codex CU still paused** (Chrome not approved).
- Box Bing/DDG HTML SERPs blocked; brand sites on unpredictable domains still under-counted.
- Spot-checked new “gold” candidates: several domain collisions → `other_not_fit` (not Top10).
- Homepage-heuristic scoring can under-count deep portfolio/FAQ pages and false-positive wrong hosts.
- Treat this Top 10 as a verified sample from 144, not a full AK web census.
- Full Scout summary: `/workspace/rainmaker/ak-gc/scored/SUMMARY.md` · SERP: `SERP_RESOLVE_SUMMARY.md`

**Card ≠ GO / no outreach until Board asks.** This brief is ranking + taxonomy only.
